question.text: The main reason offshore investors prefer jurisdictions with India DTAAs for AIF structuring is:

answer.text: To optimize taxation on Indian investment income and avoid being taxed on the same income in both India and their home country

explanation.text: The Logic: Jurisdiction choice for offshore AIF investors is heavily influenced by tax-treaty benefits. India's DTAAs are designed to avoid double taxation of the same income in both India and the investor's home country, and they directly affect the Indian tax consequences for offshore investors. Section 90(2) of the Income-tax Act allows treaty provisions to be applied where they are more beneficial than the domestic law. The Trap: DTAAs do not eliminate all taxes — they allocate taxing rights between countries and provide mechanisms such as tax credits or exemptions to prevent double taxation. Note: Under Section 90(2) of the Income-tax Act, an offshore investor can apply DTAA provisions whenever they are more beneficial than the domestic Indian tax rules.
